findings: Raw prices are close per set (1.01 and 1.07 of raw), so the x1.25 margin is what made the round come in under projection.
breakdown-routes is underpriced: 1,520 tokens per request on held-out against 972 projected, and 2,235 against 1,780 on :breakdown (+20% and +27% in stage tokens). The margin covered it.
breakdown-forms is overcounted, as in round 3: the stand-in answers open more forms requests (117 projected, 81 sent on :breakdown).

The morphemes pricing gap is confirmed: breakdown-words was priced at 2,036 tokens per request (this pass's same-stage fit from constituents' shapes) and cost 448, near the 411 the prep measured. breakdown-morphemes went the other way: 3 requests projected, 9 sent.
The held-out sense addition was right: 13 contested held-out words (as predicted) took 39 requests and 15,932 tokens, 409 per request, inside the 20,000 added.

proposedFixes.fix: A sense-led route for a base that spells a noun and a verb stem
proposedFixes.fixes: D: up to 13 attempts, 6 cases (7 H)
proposedFixes.detail: When the verb and noun tests both say yes (or for a compound's first part that spells both), ask the sense question across the two routes: 'made from kreuzen, so that it is a ship that cruises' against 'made from Kreuz'. Kreuzer 🪙 (NOUN, passing) is the guard. Tune on Erbrecht, Steuermann, Messer 📏 and Bauer 🧑‍🌾, which are tuning cases now. Compounds like Segelboot (a boat that sails, or one with a sail) may not split by sense at all, so whether DWDS's verb call for a compound's first part should be scored as exact is a question for the user.

proposedFixes.fix: Ask the sense check as one relative question
proposedFixes.fixes: S1 + S2: 10 attempts, 4 cases (7 H), Laster 🚚's regression included
proposedFixes.detail: Independent yes-or-no answers put real -er derivations at 0.32-0.47 and simplexes at 0.28-0.46, and none's fit is one minus the best answer, so every pick under 0.5 hands none more than 0.5. One choice question over the contenders and none ('which of these gives der Laster 🚚 its sense?') compares them directly. A threshold fix doesn't work: one that keeps Laster 🚚 (0.34-0.39) would also stop Sticker 🏷's right flips (0.35-0.38). Tune on the tuning pairs: Laster, Leiter, Bauer, Messer, Rentier, Gründung and Stimmung.
